from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section6Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Initialize Layout
        self.setup_layout(
            "Application: Quantum Computing",
            [
                "Classical bits process one path at a time.",
                "Qubits explore every possible path simultaneously.",
                "This allows computers to solve complex problems instantly."
            ]
        )

        # Maze Setup in grid area B2 to E5
        tl = self.grid["B2"]
        br = self.grid["E5"]
        width = br[0] - tl[0]
        height = tl[1] - br[1] # height is negative magnitude
        
        def g(r, c):
            # Calculate node position within the B2-E5 area
            return tl + np.array([c * (width / 3), -r * (height / -3), 0])

        maze_walls = VGroup(
            Line(g(0,0), g(0,3)), # Top
            Line(g(3,0), g(3,3)), # Bottom
            Line(g(0,0), g(3,0)), # Left
            Line(g(0,3), g(3,3)), # Right
            # Internal Walls
            Line(g(1,0), g(1,2)),
            Line(g(2,1), g(2,3)),
            Line(g(0,1), g(2,1)),
            Line(g(1,2), g(3,2)),
        ).set_color(GRAY).set_stroke(width=4)

        start_label = Text("START", font_size=18, color=WHITE)
        self.place_at_grid(start_label, "F2", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        exit_label = Text("EXIT", font_size=18, color=WHITE)
        self.place_at_grid(exit_label, "A5", scale_factor=0.8)

        self.add(maze_walls, start_label, exit_label)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Highlight first line
        self.lecture[0].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # White dot representing a classical bit
        white_dot = Dot(color=WHITE, radius=0.1)
        white_dot.move_to(g(3,0))
        self.add(white_dot)
        
        # Sequential path: Start -> (3,1) -> (2,1) -> (1,1) -> (1,2) -> (0,2) -> (0,3)
        path = [g(3,1), g(2,1), g(1,1), g(1,2), g(0,2), g(0,3)]
        
        for pos in path:
            self.play(white_dot.animate.move_to(pos), run_time=0.5, rate_func=linear)
        
        self.wait(0.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Reset color and highlight second line
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#00FFFF") # Blue-Cyan color
        
        # Move white dot back to start for comparison
        self.play(white_dot.animate.move_to(g(3,0)), run_time=0.5)

        # Create many blue dots to represent a superposition "gas"
        blue_dots = VGroup(*[Dot(color="#00FFFF", radius=0.08) for _ in range(13)])
        for dot in blue_dots:
            dot.move_to(g(3,0))
        self.add(blue_dots)

        # Destinations for dots to simulate "filling" the maze
        destinations = [
            g(3,1), g(3,2), g(3,3),
            g(2,0), g(2,1), g(2,2),
            g(1,0), g(1,1), g(1,2),
            g(0,0), g(0,1), g(0,2), g(0,3)
        ]

        # Animate blue dots spreading simultaneously
        self.play(
            LaggedStart(
                *[dot.animate.move_to(dest) for dot, dest in zip(blue_dots, destinations)],
                lag_ratio=0.05
            ),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(0.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Reset color and highlight third line
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(GREEN)
        
        # The dot at the exit pulses
        exit_qubit = blue_dots[-1] # The one that reached g(0,3)
        
        # While the exit is "found" by the qubit, the classical dot starts moving again
        self.play(
            Indicate(exit_qubit, color=GREEN, scale_factor=1.5),
            white_dot.animate.move_to(g(3,1)),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # Show classical dot still trying while quantum is done
        self.play(white_dot.animate.move_to(g(2,1)), run_time=0.5)
        
        self.wait(2)
